ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Paid_Amount__c < 0, Paid_Amount__c > Total_Amount__c, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Due_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Invoice_Date__c)), Due_Date__c < Invoice_Date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Paid amount must be between zero and invoice total; due date cannot precede invoice date.
